text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having decided to retire, Wonder Acute 
shows her running to her Trainer one last 
time— only for Hokko Tarumae to challenge 
her alongside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Wonder Acute in the Kawasaki 
Kinen woke her up, she said. Wanting to 
learn from her running, she demanded a 
challenge in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute agreed to compete in the JBC 
Classic just this once. The fiery passion 
of the new generation made her reconsider 
retirement.
